params.body:
Accounts: an account on gentells.com can be deleted from its panel, as its own step under Block.

**Delete this account** opens a field: the account's address has to be typed back before **Delete for good** works, so a click on the wrong row cannot do it. The site deletes the account, its keys and its history, and refuses an account that still pays (site #191, pipeline #261).

Build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling, 30 e2e pass.
params.title: Accounts: delete an account
